INSERT INTO nw_chat_session_outbox_webhook_deliveries (id,tenant_id,subscription_id,outbox_event_id,event_id,session_id,session_sequence,status,attempts,available_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES
(#{row.id},#{row.tenantId},#{row.subscriptionId},#{row.outboxEventId},#{row.eventId},#{row.sessionId},#{row.sessionSequence}, #{row.status},#{row.attempts},#{row.availableAt},#{row.createdAt},#{row.updatedAt})
ON CONFLICT (subscription_id,outbox_event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH first_pending AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, attempts FROM nw_chat_session_outbox_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND subscription_id=#{subscriptionId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND status IN ('queued', 'publishing') ORDER BY session_sequence, id LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE nw_chat_session_outbox_webhook_deliveries AS delivery SET status='publishing', attempts=delivery.attempts + 1, claimed_at=#{now}, error_code=NULL, updated_at=#{now} FROM first_pending WHERE delivery.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND delivery.id=first_pending.id AND delivery.attempts=first_pending.attempts AND ((delivery.status='queued' AND (delivery.available_at IS NULL OR delivery.available_at <= #{now})) OR (delivery.status='publishing' AND (delivery.claimed_at IS NULL OR delivery.claimed_at <= #{expiredBefore}))) RETURNING delivery.id AS "deliveryId", delivery.outbox_event_id AS "outboxEventId", delivery.attempts
mapper.sql: tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{claim.deliveryId} AND status='publishing' AND attempts=#{claim.attempts}
